data.title: kadence init guides a person at a terminal (Coda)
data.description: The flows recorded in docs/onboarding-prototype (A1-A5): what was found, one question with a recommended setup, customize (agents, columns, definition of done), ADR import with a preview, one decision by hand, what a teammate's agent will see, a line for a teammate, commit and undo. Re-running init is a checkup. clack-style prompts hand-rolled, zero dependencies, loaded lazily.
